photos.c: This picture was taken by Ed Lacey at Parliament Hill just after the start of the Southern Senior Championships of 1954. That man out front?----Why, "Jumbo" Masters of course.
Middle left: D.A.G. Pirie (SLH) leads Frank Sando (Aylesford) in the "Southern" Cross Country Champs. of 1953. Spectating (in the cap) is Mavis' father Tom Morell.
